description: Proficiency Writs as key items: names (section 61 sub-table 12), section-35 rows (in use, key-item icon) and Key Items menu descriptions (listhelp_daijinamono.bin). Proficiency grants them through the native key-item setter before any rank is rewarded.

items.name: Apprentice's Writ
items.description:
A writ from Montblanc vouching for your skill in your
chosen jobs. Its bearer may draw on Proficiency I.

items.name: Journeyman's Writ
items.description:
Montblanc's writ for members proven in many hunts.
Its bearer may draw on Proficiency II.

items.name: Master's Writ
items.description:
The highest writ Clan Centurio grants.
Its bearer may draw on Proficiency III.
